prompt: Use case: ui-mockup. Produce an outstanding high fidelity native iPhone app DESIGN CONCEPT board, 1536x2048 portrait canvas, exactly TWO tall portrait screen designs side by side, same size, no device hardware, no perspective. Reference image is the user's approved HARBOR BRAND IDENTITY, not a screen to edit: faithfully carry the Harbor arch/sun/water logo, navy #0D2747, blue #2F8CE6, wave #7CC3F3, mist #E8F0F8, sun #FFDFA6, slate #1E293B. Preserve Harbor wordmark character using bold Inter for branding; SF Pro for native UI and SF Symbols for controls. Brand is calm, private, focused, open, reliable. This is a persistent everyday browser with 42 open tabs, not incognito. Concept preview, all web content is synthetic. Render actual working app surfaces, not marketing landing pages. Slim board title above screens, restrained board footer, most of board devoted to screens. Screens themselves must be realistic 402x874pt native iPhone layouts with safe areas, status bar and home indicator. Text readable, labels and touch targets spacious. Modern Apple LIQUID GLASS: floating bottom address/search capsule and separate compact rounded toolbar controls, subtle optical edge highlights, refracted blurred content visible beneath, adaptive contrast, sculpted transparent edges with NO neon glow, no thick chrome, no cheap frosted rectangle covering the whole screen. Glass is exclusively navigation/control layer, content rows and preview cards are opaque conventional surfaces. Native sheets, buttons, search, and lists; no made-up radial gestures. No fake tracker counts or privacy scores. One small shield with descriptive status only. Keep each concept distinct by its spatial composition, not just tint. The user already rejected simple palette changes over identical layouts. Do not reproduce the reference brand BOARD, create native browser screens using it. Footer "Harbor • Concept exploration • Future groups shown". Board title "Horizon" subtitle "An open place to return to". Dramatic, image-led, calm branded HOME. Left screen: top area deep navy horizon fading into blue reflective water and warm pale sun, the reference arch mark appearing small above wordmark Harbor, NOT giant overlaid decoration. This landscape backdrop is authored Harbor start-page artwork only, never webpage recoloring. Content from middle down: section "Continue browsing" with a SINGLE wide opaque thumbnail card "A slower weekend" / fieldnotes.example and small "Everyday"; then four modest favorite shortcuts named Wikipedia, GitHub, Are.na, Weather; very light airy organization. Tiny neutral shield with "Blocking on". Bottom floating luminous glass address capsule "Search or enter address"; lower glass toolbar with back, forward, plus, tab count 42, more. Right screen: TAB OVERVIEW over dark navy with faint same horizon only behind chrome, title "42 tabs", floating native search "Search all tabs", compact glass group scope control "Everyday 18" dropdown. Main content 2-column large OPAQUE preview grid with realistic little pages and white caption rails: A slower weekend / fieldnotes.example; Train times / rail.example; Camera comparison / camera.example; Dinner ideas / kitchen.example. First selected with blue thin outline. Native close at top of each. Bottom floating glass controls plus, group menu, Done. Make entire visual feel expansive blue water and restrained warm sun. Screen labels above "Start" and "Tabs". No ornamental wallpaper pattern. Distinct silhouette: large open scenic upper half on home; large page previews on tabs.
